name: Telluric-Mausoleum
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws an ancient meteor crater, patient as erosion itself.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Slow groves of photosynthetic columns migrate centimeters a season toward the light.

The colonists of the derelict space station in orbit kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on rare flora, solar potential and silicon are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
